costumeStyle: 女性化白／深紫黑／细金边、裙装、白色腿部服装和紫色鞋靴，贴近角色参考图。

shots.action: 固定海岸宽景连续14秒，保留原海浪、道路与房屋；右下蓝蝶保持同一位置和清晰身体结构，两侧翅膀围绕身体根部自然对称开合，每约4秒完成一次舒缓周期，短暂停歇；不翻转、不扭曲、不拖出重影。片尾文字仍由后期叠加。
shots.prompt: A single continuous fourteen-second fixed wide landscape view of Picture 1. From the first frame to the last frame the entire image remains this same seaside establishing view, with exactly the same horizon, empty pebble shore, road, poles, houses and open sky at the same camera position and scale. Keep the original distant coastline visible for all fourteen seconds. Only the small sea wave edges advance and recede gently. The original tiny blue butterfly symbol in the lower-right corner stays anchored at its original size and location; its own two wings open and close gently at their central join about once every four seconds, easing slowly into a brief pause at rest. Its markings and outline stay coherent. The camera never approaches or follows this symbol. Preserve the complete original coastal background throughout its movement. No cut, transition, zoom, macro view, reframing, new scenery, new vegetation, extra insect, person, human body, reflection, text, speech, voice, singing or humming.
